_help: Node/TypeScript preset. Each gate runs in its target's dir (the repo root for a single-app config); every required gate must exit 0 before a slice can be marked verified. Adjust the scripts to match this repo's package.json; delete gates you don't have; add integration/e2e/coverage gates you do.
session_budget_hint: A slice should fit one agent session: ~1 vertical behavior, < ~10 files touched, tests included. If it won't fit in your head, split it.
